ai.intro: When the language changes, task titles, descriptions, notes, remarks and service tickets are translated by AI too. Each text is translated once and cached (later views are free and fast). Get a key and enter it here:
ai.stepGemini: Free: aistudio.google.com → "Get API key" → create a key (Google account, no card). Free limit ~1000 requests/day, up to 40 texts per request
ai.stepAnthropic: Paid, high quality: console.anthropic.com → API Keys (Claude Haiku is the cheapest model)
ai.stepSave: Choose the provider, enter the key, turn on "Auto-translate" and save. The key is verified and stored encrypted
ai.keySaved: Key saved (encrypted). Enter a new one to replace it
ai.keyHint: The key is stored encrypted on the server and never shown
ai.privacy: Texts are sent to the chosen AI service. On the free Gemini tier Google may use the data to improve its models; for confidential data use a paid tier or Claude. Names, numbers and codes are kept. The original shows on hover
